items.stem: You want answers about a scanned form to stay faithful to the document. What should the prompt require?

options.text: That answers come only from the provided media and say so when the information is not present
options.rationale: Correct: grounding to the source prevents answers drawn from general knowledge.

options.text: That the model fill any gaps with its best general guess
options.rationale: Guessing undermines grounding and invites errors.

options.text: That the model ignore the document and use its training data
options.rationale: Ignoring the source defeats the task.

options.text: That the answer always be a single word
options.rationale: Answer length is unrelated to grounding faithfulness.

items.explanation: Correct: grounding to the source prevents answers drawn from general knowledge.
items.domain_ref: Working with image and document inputs
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A scan is low quality and OCR is uncertain. Which TWO responses are appropriate? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Return an explicit 'cannot determine' for fields that are unreadable
options.rationale: Correct: flagging unreadable fields is safer than guessing.

options.text: Flag low confidence so a human can review the uncertain fields
options.rationale: Correct: surfacing uncertainty routes hard cases to review.

options.text: Invent the most likely value and present it as certain
options.rationale: Presenting guesses as certain is unsafe.

options.text: Silently drop the document from the results
options.rationale: Silently dropping data hides the problem.

items.explanation: Correct: flagging unreadable fields is safer than guessing.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: The model gives a confident answer about a blurry chart. What is the correct stance?

options.text: Verify the answer against the media; confidence on degraded input is not reliable
options.rationale: Correct: confidence does not compensate for poor-quality input.

options.text: Accept it because the model sounded sure
options.rationale: Confidence is not evidence on degraded media.

options.text: Assume blurry images are always read correctly

items.explanation: Correct: confidence does not compensate for poor-quality input.
